CFML Language Reference: Functions

Asc

Returns the character code (0-255) of the first character of a string. The rest of the string is ignored.

Category

String functions

Syntax

Asc(string)

Parameters

string
Any string. Only its first character is examined.

Returns

A number from 1 to 255, or 0 if the string is empty.

Usage

Chr does the opposite trip. Asc is handy for spotting stray control characters (a tab is 9, a carriage return 13, a line feed 10) in text that came from a form or a file.

Example

Opens the example in a new window. The example runs on this server, so it only works when you browse from the server itself (127.0.0.1).
<CFSET Letters = "A,a,Z,0,~">
<TABLE BORDER=1 CELLPADDING=3>
<TR><TH>Character</TH><TH>Asc()</TH></TR>
<CFLOOP LIST="#Letters#" INDEX="ch">
<CFOUTPUT><TR><TD ALIGN="CENTER">#ch#</TD><TD ALIGN="RIGHT">#Asc(ch)#</TD></TR></CFOUTPUT>
</CFLOOP>
</TABLE>
<CFOUTPUT><P>Asc("KoldFusion") looks only at the K: #Asc("KoldFusion")#</P></CFOUTPUT>
